beneficiary: A caregiver can resume exact editable venue questions, replies and next steps during a later visit to the same saved plan.
behavior: Explicit Save venue notes, Open venue notes, preview, then Replace venue notes; no automatic storage or upload.

A separate bounded UTF-8 v1 JSON companion contains the exact accepted plan origin (receivedAt, calendarId, original inputs and full response) and all retained occurrence/date records, including currently omitted or other-date notes.

Reopen the original saved week first. The origin must match completely; current assignment and displayed week need not match. Do not change plan, original checks, assignments, calendar or requester inputs.

Preserve question null/default distinction, original replyQuestions and questions-changed status. Reject malformed notes, duplicate identities, unsupported status/field/length, invalid dates and inconsistent recorded-reply association before replacing any current record.
File limit 2 MiB, maximum 256 retained occurrence/date records; original in-tab notes remain unchanged if save exceeds this explicit portable-file limit.
Preview describes exact filename/save time, record count, matching-current-visit count and replacement. Empty files explicitly clear notes only upon Replace.
A current plan/date/assignment change, note edit, newer file, cancellation or retirement makes a pending read or preview obsolete. Refused or cancelled opens preserve current notes.
Use literal text, keyboard controls and readable 390px layout. Fresh valid retry after refusal must work.

receiving.originalBrowser: Open the exact already-published native saved-week artifact through the existing real chooser, enter a literal note, save the week, reload and reopen it; existing editable note is gone and a companion-note restore control is absent.
receiving.author: Focused model/codec negatives and actual browser file-chooser/download/reload/preview/replace path with exact byte retention and original-source checks.
receiving.independent: Separate receiver to challenge repeated venue IDs and old-date reply-question history, source mismatch, and stale replacement after a newer accepted origin.
